summaries.Business Analyst: Business Analyst driving measurable outcomes across organisations and stakeholders. Proven ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured requirements, execute gap analyses, and deliver Agile-aligned products.
summaries.Full Stack Engineer: Full Stack Engineer with a product mindset, specialising in React.js, Node.js, and MongoDB. Proven ability to build and scale cross-functional systems that improve efficiency and drive measurable business growth.
summaries.Data Engineer: Data-driven professional with strong skills in Python, SQL, and data reporting tools. Experienced in building unified engagement dashboards, consolidating scattered data into single sources of truth, and running gap analyses.
summaries.Product Manager: Product Manager and thinker with full-stack development skills. Proven ability to translate business problems into requirements, align cross-functional teams in Agile sprints, and execute strategic roadmaps from brief to UAT.
summaries.Technical Staff Member: Technical Staff Member with strong cross-functional coordination skills. Experienced in building tools and tracking mechanisms that eliminate process ambiguity and reduce procurement/decision times.
summaries.Frontend Engineer: Frontend Engineer focused on building intuitive, real-time web applications. Experienced in React.js and creating full-stack web apps with complex search, filtering, and interactive dashboards.
summaries.Backend Engineer: Backend Engineer proficient in Node.js, REST APIs, and MongoDB. Experienced in designing robust RESTful endpoints for CRUD operations and structuring scalable schemas to support multi-field filtering and reporting.
summaries.TPM: Technical Program Manager with a track record of orchestrating cross-functional teams in Agile sprints. Adept at enforcing UAT sign-offs, executing gap analyses, and reducing post-release rework and process ambiguity.

education.coursework: SDLC, System Design, Database Management Systems, Software Engineering

bullets.text: Executed gap analysis on a 40%+ decline in B2B orders; reframed business model from B2B to B2C by synthesising requirements from sales, ops, and marketing stakeholders — launched Rakhi campaign that sold 200 boxes and delivered 300% growth in social impressions within 4 weeks.

Engineered a centralised Excel tracker covering 100+ manufacturers — consolidating supplier profiles, order timelines, and financial data into a single source of truth, cutting procurement decision time by ~30% and eliminating duplicate supplier outreach.

Orchestrated a 10-person cross-functional team across ops, logistics, and marketing in Agile sprints; enforced UAT-equivalent sign-off against defined acceptance criteria before each campaign launch, cutting post-release rework by ~40%.

Scaled regional tech community 5x — from 0 to 550+ members — across 7+ offline events; built a unified engagement dashboard in Google Sheets and Notion tracking attendance, task completion, and event ROI, cutting reporting time by ~50%.

Diagnosed a 30%+ drop in active participation through qualitative root cause analysis; redesigned member experience with weekly standups and a points-based incentive system — reversing churn and lifting retention by ~35% within 6 weeks.

Codified onboarding from scratch into a structured, reusable event playbook adopted organisation-wide — reducing new coordinator ramp-up time by ~25% and eliminating repeated process ambiguity across regions.

Activated 12 communities, onboarding 800+ students within 3 months; crafted sponsor pitch decks and coordination briefs for 3+ tech events, cutting partner onboarding cycles by ~2x through structured documentation.

Ran a structured gap analysis on a fully-online engagement model; surfaced trust deficit as the primary drop-off driver and redesigned touchpoint strategy — increasing active participation rates by ~40% within 4 weeks.

Replaced a manual Excel-based supplier tracker at InTheBox with a full-stack web app — featuring real-time search and filtering, order status tracking, and one-click exportable reports across 100+ manufacturer profiles.

Designed RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on supplier and order data; structured MongoDB schema to support multi-field filtering and financial reporting — enabling data-driven procurement decisions without manual effort.

certifications: Conceptualised and delivered India’s first Ivy League MUN — owned full stakeholder pipeline from speaker outreach to delegate briefing; executed a 100+ participant event end-to-end as sole organiser.

Coached 5+ national-level teams at CodeX 2.0 PIET on requirement breakdown, MVP scoping, and structured project planning — measurably improving submission quality and on-time delivery rates across mentored teams.
